title: Late-night food
summary: Food trucks at Narmada and Sabarmati, Cream Stone, Nescafe, Dollar Café.

posts.md:
**Late-Night Food Options**

Need food after dinner or during late-night study sessions? Our College has a few food trucks that operate at night.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Narmada Hostel Food Trucks**

There are **two food trucks** in front of Narmada Hostel.

Truck 1

- Dosas

- Uttapams

Truck 2

- Burgers

- Sandwiches

https://maps.app.goo.gl/y9eKf72Qma7ZBqAT9
**Sabarmati Hostel Food Truck**

Serves:

- Fried Rice

- Noodles

https://maps.app.goo.gl/9Sk5E9UZtRpYe3gn8

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
